changes.title: Custom combat effects
changes.text: Implemented maximum-health, accuracy and evasion factors from locked custom settings, with startup health separated from healing.

changes.title: Custom upgrade supply
changes.text: Implemented whole-scroll dungeon allocations from 1 to 60; 15 keeps original generation, and Forbidden Runes retains its existing reduction.

changes.title: Custom slider regressions
changes.text: Added combat, health save/load and all-count dungeon-generation tests, including Forbidden Runes and neutral random-number checks.

changes.title: Verification and alpha records
changes.text: Documented the failed startup-health and changelog-sprite checks, their corrections and remaining custom-slider work.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I added the initial custom combat factors and configurable upgrade supply, then corrected verification failures. The remaining sliders and native controls are still in development.
